title: Sriracha Deviled Eggs
description: Sriracha deviled eggs are tasty and easy to make. If you love Sriracha's spicy kick and hard-boiled eggs, you'll surely enjoy this 7-ingredient recipe.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Sriracha hot chili sauce, or more to taste
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
1 pinch smoked paprika, or to taste

steps.text: Place eggs in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, remove from heat, and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 minutes. Remove eggs from hot water, cool under cold running water, and peel.

Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Place egg yolks in a bowl; mash with a fork. Add mayonnaise, Sriracha, dry mustard, and cayenne pepper; mash until smooth. Season with salt. Spoon yolk mixture into a resealable plastic bag; snip off one corner of the bag.
Place egg whites, cut-sides up, on a serving platter. Pipe yolk mixture into egg white halves; sprinkle with smoked paprika. Refrigerate deviled eggs, covered, until ready to serve.
